name: Shortening
siboNotes: Pure shortening is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Use in moderation as high fat intake can slow gastric emptying.
preparationTips: Check labels to ensure no added flavors or ingredients
Store in cool, dry place to maintain consistency
Allow to come to room temperature for easier mixing in baking
Can be substituted 1:1 for butter in most recipes
alternatives: avocado oil for liquid fat needs
